ns2:section.sectionText: Note: College of Media majors and Agricultural Communications majors should register for section CX (CRN 51491). All other students may register for this section. There are a limited number of seats available for each class level. If you receive the error message "RESERVE CLOSED", that means that the seats for your class level are full and you will have to wait until a student in your class level drops the course and try again at a later time. Questions may be directed to the College of Media Student Services Center at 244-4329 or via e-mail at media-ssc@illinois.edu.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for College of Media. Not intended for Agr & Environmental Cmc & Educ major(s).
